title: 万象のアンサンブル：空を舞う絶唱の旅路
author: 吟遊 ノクト

en.title: Ensemble of All Creation: A Journey of Soaring Arias
en.premise: In a world afflicted by the 'Silence Sickness' where sound is slowly fading away, there are those who sing out their despair. A boy who gathers lost melodies aboard a flying ship, and a girl who connects lonely souls through a radio at dawn. Together, these discordant souls are guided toward the 'Final Song' to retune the world.

zh.title: 万象合奏曲：翱翔天际的绝唱之旅
zh.premise: 在一个声音逐渐消逝、被“静寂之病”侵蚀的世界里，存在着一群歌唱绝望的人们。一名在飞船上收集失落旋律的少年，与一名通过黎明广播连接孤独灵魂的少女。奏响着不和谐音符的他们，正被引导向那首为了重新调律世界而存在的“最后一曲”。
